label: Under the #733/#734 joint-group profile: for every graph, Mathlib strongly connected component…
meaning: Prove condensation invariants through Mathlib quiver components. Induct on Supply for the forward map. Take a minimal component meeting a nonempty active set to reduce Escape to component escape, and compose the #734 Supply/Escape equivalence. Then test every hypothesis on fixed record structures, reusing the #634 records, the #711 circle, the #734 source-free chain and the #735 plural fixture. Root premise delta zero; no actual explanatory bridge is established. Under the #733/#734 joint-group profile: for every graph, Mathlib strongly connected component condensation is acyclic and preserves and reflects finite reachability, weak connection and leastness, and sources pass to it; a finite carrier gives it well-foundedness. Supply passes from a record structure to its condensation. Over a well-founded condensation Escape coincides with escape inside components, and under LocalPower and PoweredGroups that decides Supply of every active event. Three record structures on one three-event membership graph with one source and a two-event cycle have the same condensation into a two-component chain: t needing s and u has no Supply of t or u, separate records for t give Supply of every event, and u as enabler gives Supply of every event. On that carrier no function of the projected graph and intrinsic set decides Supply. Controls: Trap has no scenario parameter while u is indispensable over two scenarios and redundant over one; the #634 graph carries records with component escape but not Escape and other records with Supply of every event, its condensation not being well-founded; a source-free chain has component escape without Supply; a loop chain has condensed Supply, component escape, LocalPower and PoweredGroups without Supply; a two-event cycle is a condensation source without a graph source, has LocalPower and record-reason FactPSR without Supply when no member is intrinsic, and has Supply when one is; the #735 plural fixture has Supply with two source components and no least one. Supply remains a proposed standard: actual exercise, productive adequacy, necessity and physical-to-existential bridges remain OPEN and circular or coherentist rivals who reject Supply are not refuted.
